author: _Tony
body:
• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)- _Tony, (previously known as Tonyfamous)
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned -I was banned for 'attempting to crash the server'
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
~At the day where I 'attempted to crash the server', I did not mean to do so. I was going up the bridge and placing stairs at the same time. I accidentally switched to my water bucket which is next to my stack of blocks, and placed the bucket. I fell, and climbed back up, then picked up the water. I didn't know it affected the server to lag, until players in the server reacted weird. I was going to confess to a moderator that I did it, but I thought it wasn't really a big deal as it only lasted for a few minutes. Then, I cockily posted on the Overcast forums that I crashed it, and I know that was my mistake. To sumarize it all up, I only thought it was funny to make a post regarding to the whole situation, but I didn't mean to place the water bucket. Thanks for taking your time and consider if I should be pardoned or remain banned.

title: My appeal. (_Tony)

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

We saw the post on the OCN forums before it was taken down.

I know you were intentionally trying to crash the server.

This appeal is denied.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
